def replay(manifest_path, responses_path):
    man = load_manifest(manifest_path)
    _probes, probe_meta, segments = build_plan(man, with_probes=False)
    attempts = man["attempts"]

    data = read_bounded(responses_path, REPLAY_LIMIT)
    rows = split_rows(data)
    if len(rows) > MAX_LINES:
        raise InvalidInput("too many physical lines")

    diagnostics = []
    accepted_rows = 0
    duplicate_rows = 0
    seen = set()
    accepted_by_probe = {}

    for idx, (content, byte_len) in enumerate(rows):
        line_no = idx + 1
        if byte_len > MAX_LINE_BYTES:
            raise InvalidInput("physical line too long")
        # json check
        try:
            obj = decode_json(content)
        except InvalidInput:
            diagnostics.append({"line": line_no, "reason": "json"})
            continue
        # schema
        if not isinstance(obj, dict) or set(obj.keys()) != ROW_KEYS:
            diagnostics.append({"line": line_no, "reason": "schema"})
            continue
        probe_id = obj["probe_id"]
        target = obj["target"]
        source = obj["source"]
        if (not isinstance(probe_id, str) or not isinstance(target, str)
                or not isinstance(source, str)):
            diagnostics.append({"line": line_no, "reason": "schema"})
            continue
        if len(probe_id) == 0 or len(probe_id) > 200:
            diagnostics.append({"line": line_no, "reason": "schema"})
            continue
        if (not is_int(obj["received_ms"]) or not is_int(obj["type"])
                or not is_int(obj["code"])):
            diagnostics.append({"line": line_no, "reason": "schema"})
            continue
        # address
        try:
            target_int = parse_address(target)
            source_int = parse_address(source)
        except InvalidInput:
            diagnostics.append({"line": line_no, "reason": "address"})
            continue
        # unknown_probe
        meta = probe_meta.get(probe_id)
        if meta is None:
            diagnostics.append({"line": line_no, "reason": "unknown_probe"})
            continue
        planned_target, sent, deadline = meta
        # target_mismatch
        if target_int != planned_target:
            diagnostics.append({"line": line_no, "reason": "target_mismatch"})
            continue
        # time
        received = obj["received_ms"]
        if not (sent <= received < deadline):
            diagnostics.append({"line": line_no, "reason": "time"})
            continue
        # icmp
        typ = obj["type"]
        code = obj["code"]
        if not (typ == 129 and code == 0) and not (
                typ == 1 and 0 <= code <= 6):
            diagnostics.append({"line": line_no, "reason": "icmp"})
            continue

        key = (probe_id, received, target_int, source_int, typ, code)
        if key in seen:
            duplicate_rows += 1
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        accepted_rows += 1
        accepted_by_probe.setdefault(probe_id, []).append(
            (source_int, typ, code))

    seg_results = reconcile(segments, accepted_by_probe, attempts)
    return {
        "version": 1,
        "accepted_rows": accepted_rows,
        "duplicate_rows": duplicate_rows,
        "diagnostics": diagnostics,
        "segments": seg_results,
    }
